How to publish it for free

We'll use GitHub Pages.

  1. Open GitHub and create a free account.

  2. Create a new repository called the-archive.

  3. Upload the index.html file from the ZIP.

  4. Go to Settings → Pages.
  5. Select Deploy from a branch → main → /root → Save.
  6. GitHub will give you a public website address.

That address becomes the destination of your universal QR code.
